title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship that teaches how to write readable, maintainable, and elegant code.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: David Thomas, Andrew Hunt
description: A guide to becoming a more effective and efficient programmer through practical tips and philosophies.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: A deep dive into the principles and practicalities of distributed systems and data engineering.

title: You Don't Know JS
author: Kyle Simpson
description: A deep dive into the core mechanisms of JavaScript, dispelling myths and misconceptions.

title: The Linux Command Line
author: William Shotts
description: A complete introduction to the world of the Linux command line, from basic navigation to shell scripting.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: A comedic science fiction series following Arthur Dent as he travels the universe after Earth is demolished.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopian novel set in a totalitarian society ruled by Big Brother, exploring surveillance and freedom.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: An epic science fiction saga set on the desert planet Arrakis, exploring politics, religion, and ecology.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A portrait of the Jazz Age in all of its decadence and excess, centered around the mysterious Jay Gatsby.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A powerful story of racial injustice and moral growth in the American South, seen through the eyes of Scout Finch.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: The novel that defined the cyberpunk genre, following a washed-up hacker hired for one last job.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An accessible exploration of cosmology, from the Big Bang to black holes and the nature of time.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A revolutionary view of evolution that places the gene, rather than the organism, at the centre of natural selection.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping narrative of humanity's creation and evolution, exploring how biology and history defined what it means to be human.

title: The Gene: An Intimate History
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
description: A compelling history of genetics that weaves personal narrative with scientific breakthroughs.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A personal voyage through the universe, exploring the nature of science and the origin of life.

title: The Innovators
author: Walter Isaacson
description: A story of the people who created the computer and the internet, exploring the nature of innovation and collaboration.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: An examination of the factors that led to the dominance of certain civilizations over others across history.

title: The Rise and Fall of the Third Reich
author: William L. Shirer
description: A comprehensive and authoritative history of Nazi Germany based on captured documents and firsthand observation.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: The personal diary of Anne Frank, a Jewish girl hiding in Amsterdam during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands.

title: Longitude
author: Dava Sobel
description: The story of John Harrison, who solved the greatest scientific problem of his time: how to determine longitude at sea.

title: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
description: An ancient Chinese military treatise that has influenced military strategy and management thinking for centuries.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, incremental changes.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: Rules for focused success in a distracted world, arguing that the ability to focus is a superpower.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: A groundbreaking tour of the mind that explores the two systems that drive the way we think.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
description: A Holocaust survivor's account of finding meaning in suffering, forming the basis of logotherapy.

title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen R. Covey
description: A principle-centered approach for solving personal and professional problems through seven effectiveness habits.

title: How to Win Friends and Influence People
author: Dale Carnegie
description: Timeless advice on human relations: how to make people like you, win people to your way of thinking, and be a leader.

title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
author: Harold Abelson, Gerald Jay Sussman
description: The classic MIT textbook on programming, using Scheme to teach the fundamentals of computer science.

title: The Double Helix
author: James D. Watson
description: A personal account of the discovery of the structure of DNA, revealing the competitive and human side of science.
